_about: What Prosio needs, and what being full or lacking each thing does to him. Levels are 0 to 100.

stores._about: What he is made of besides fat and muscle.

FRAME.about: kg of him that never change: bones, and the rest

STORE_KG.about: What each store weighs when it is full, in kg. (Vitamins and electrolytes weigh nothing.)

DEADLY.about: Having run right out of these ends the game, if it lasts.

FIBRE_KCAL.about: calories of fibre to a kilogram of his fibre store

VITAMIN_KCAL.about: calories of vitamins to a point of his vitamins level

SALT_KCAL.about: and of electrolytes to a point of that level

levels._about: Where each level starts, where lacking, full and too much begin, and how fast levels go down.

NEED_START.about: where each level but water starts; above it, vitamins and electrolytes go in more slowly the fuller he is

NEED_EMPTY.about: below this he has run out

NEED_HIGH.about: above this he is full of it

NEED_OVER.about: above this it is too much

WATER_LOW.about: below this he lacks water (water has its own line, higher than NEED_LOW)

NEED_FADE.about: the share of his protein, fibre, vitamins and electrolytes used up every second, at rest: half of each in a day (0.6931 is the natural log of 2). Carbs are burned instead (see BASAL in prosio.json), and water has its own THIRST

SHED.about: above NEED_OVER the share of it that moves on every second: too much of anything is over in a few minutes, as it was before the day was long (it does not follow NEED_FADE)

THIRST.about: water level used up every second: a full drink lasts a good quarter of an hour

TOO_LONG.about: seconds without water, vitamins or electrolytes before the game is over

LICK.about: electrolytes the goats lick off him each second

DRINK_SALT.about: electrolytes a drink washes out of him,

stomach._about: His stomach: it limits how much he eats at once, by volume. What he eats takes room in it (its weight in ITEM_KG, food.json, times STOMACH_K) and leaves it at a steady pace. He can eat while it is not full; a big piece (a pumpkin) may fill it past full, and then he must wait. What he eats still goes into him at once: the stomach only says how much more he can take.

STOMACH_K.about: litres of stomach a kilogram of food takes; raise it and food is bulkier

STOMACH_HOLDS.about: litres his stomach holds: about a kilogram of food at once; raise it and he eats more at a sitting

STOMACH_FULL.about: he is full from this share of what it holds, and eats nothing more until it is below it again: after a cabbage, about two minutes; raise it towards 1 and he waits less

STOMACH_EMPTIES.about: seconds a full stomach takes to empty: 5 hours of the game's day, 12.5 minutes of play, so about 4.8 kg of food a day (it was 8 hours, and he could not eat enough to keep his weight); raise it and he eats less a day

full_and_lacking._about: What full and lacking do, in numbers.

RUSH_SPEED.about: What full and lacking do, in numbers. sugar rush: how much faster he walks and runs,

RUSH_DRAIN.about: and the share of the usual stamina a sprint costs

CRASH_TIME.about: seconds of sugar crash when the rush wears off,

CRASH_SPEED.about: and how slow he is meanwhile

NO_FUEL.about: lacking carbs: the share of his stamina that comes back

GAS_REACH.about: animals this near run from it,

GAS_COST.about: the fibre level each one lets out

ACHE_TIME.about: and how long one stops him

EAGLE_SIGHT.about: eagle eyes: how much further he sees,

EAGLE_ZOOM.about: and how far the camera pulls back

DIM_SIGHT.about: lacking vitamins: how far he sees, as a share of the usual,

DIM_ZOOM.about: and how far the camera pulls back, as a share of the usual (under 1 brings it in)

SALTY_THIRST.about: salty: how much faster he gets thirsty

CRAMP_AFTER.about: lacking electrolytes: seconds of sprinting that bring on a cramp,

CRAMP_JUMP.about: and the share of his jump he still has

BULK_BURN.about: full of protein: how much more everything burns (how much faster muscle builds is BULK in prosio.json, muscle)

THIRSTY_STAMINA.about: thirsty: his stamina only comes back this far

too_much._about: What too much of each does.

HICCUP_EVERY.about: Too much of each: seconds between hiccups

GAS_STORM.about: seconds between winds in a gas storm, each letting out twice the fibre

GLOW_NOTICE.about: glowing: how much further off the turkeys spot him

PARCHED_THIRST.about: parched: how much faster his water goes

STIFF.about: stiff: how much longer a swing or a stoop takes
